t: Thinking in Vim: A Philosophy for Future-Proofing Your Digital Self
s: This article advocates for adopting Vim/NeoVim as a text editor to achieve digital autonomy and future-proof skills against vendor-driven obsolescence. It emphasizes investing in a stable, command-line-based skill that fosters long-term productivity, contrasting it with the transient nature of GUI applications and integrated AI tools.
sub: Philosophy of Vim as a future-proof skill vs. transient GUI tools
NeoVim advantages (Lua config) over classic Vim for customization
CLI-centric AI workflow for control and focus, separating tools from creation
Critique of designed obsolescence and vendor lock-in in software development
